comment: Remove the Certa integration helpers, callback-name exports, and certaCommon/certaBackend deep modules. Certa test suites must use @itwin/certa callback utilities and own their backendInitModule setup, including environment loading. Follow the [Certa migration guide](https://github.com/iTwin/auth-clients/blob/main/packages/oidc-signin-tool/MIGRATING_TO_V7.md#migrating-certa-tests). Non-Certa browser exports remain available from lib/cjs/frontend.
